title: Ask for Daniel.
text: Spent the tour with DANIEL. He was great, very knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. Would definitely want to ride with him again.
author: Travel15248808238

title: Daniel was amazing. Loved...
text:
Daniel was amazing. Loved the story telling and very accommodating. I forgot to bring a jacket and it stated pouring so he gave me his jacket. 

It’s a very well organised tour and the staff very efficient and friendly.
author: Mona_J

title: Ivan was fantastic and bikes were so fun!
text: Great experience with Ivan! Bikes were easy to get used to and Ivan, who is now in university for history showed his love for his hometown of Seville. Would recommend to anyone who can ride a bike!
author: Wren_W

title: Great tour and guide
text: A fun and interesting way to see the sights. Great value for money and lots of good advice about what to see and do after the bike tour.
author: Helen_Nyul

title: See more of Seville by bike
text: We have been in Seville for theee days, but the bike tour allowed us to explore the river and parks and gain some great history of the city and Spanish exploration. Daniel was funny and spoke perfect English.  It was fun to be part of an international group of many countries.  I highly recommend.
author: juliewG8580XA

title: A Wonderful Way to Discover Seville
text: We really enjoyed this bike tour of Seville! It was a great way to explore the city's main sights and discover some hidden gems along the way. The guide was friendly and knowledgeable, and the tour was well organized and enjoyable. A lovely experience and a great way to get to know Seville!
author: nadinevY235PH

title: Great tour
text: It is value for money and a great way to see Seville. Such a beautiful city. Daniel our tour guide was brilliant, very informative and made it fun.  Lovely bikes with a basket for your belongings. Many opportunities for photos. Definitely worth doing and hire place easy to find. Thank you again Daniel 🤩
author: Sarah_H

title: Bike tour in Seville
text: Was due to do this with a friend but her flight was delayed so ended up going solo! So glad I did! Ivan was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about history and culture of Seville. Easy bike ride covering about 9km with plenty of stops. Highly recommend
author: suz62878

title: Awesome!
text: Daniel was the absolute best! Kept the group organized safe & on schedule, funny, knowledgeable, and made the tour fantastic. Highly recommend.
author: Jayy_Tee_55

title: Beautiful ride by the...
text: Beautiful ride by the river, through the parks, and into the old city.  Quick stop for a beverage was perfectly timed. Guide Daniel was 10/10.
author: Jeffrey_J
